title: Cowboy Retreat-Cozy Studio Getaway
description:
Kick back and relax in this calm, stylish space. Warm & Inviting! Enjoy your own private studio-style living space with a separate entrance for easy self check-in and complete privacy. This cozy suite includes a private in-suite bathroom, kitchenette, comfortable living/sleeping area, and everything you need for a relaxing stay. Perfect for couples, solo travelers, business trips, or weekend getaways.

Please note that there is not a stove or oven.

The space
This studio apartment is located above the homeowners garage that is attached to owners primary residence. 

There is a private entrance with staircase up to studio. 

Located on 7 wooded acres that includes a pond with beautiful walking trails.

Guest access
Private entrance door located right of the 3 car garage. 

Keypad lock entrance for self check in.

Other things to note
This property shares trails, pond access and street parking with another air bnb listing located in the basement of homeowners residence.
